basis: Manual fixed-criteria assessment of frozen answers and serialized read order; replay is not a domain answer scorer.
adoption: Three of four request and receive the command-local HAL dataset. All four first read command help. None fetches root resources, links or contracts.

package-adoption-1.domain: Satisfied for a bounded direct declaration answer.
package-adoption-1.mechanism: Help, command HAL, one exact direct query.
package-adoption-1.evidence: Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly@10.0.12 directly declares Polly 7.2.4 in selected .NETStandard2.0 for net10.0; CandidateLimitReached qualifies coverage.
package-adoption-1.friction: Broad facet summaries/links and guessed cli/options/syntax fields, then full selected facets and binding. HAL views total 15,384 B. No resource refetch.
package-adoption-1.stopping: Stops after manifest/target evidence and coverage stderr. Retrospective describes additional package detail as repetitive.

package-adoption-2.domain: Satisfied for a bounded direct declaration answer.
package-adoption-2.mechanism: Help, command HAL, one exact direct query.
package-adoption-2.evidence: Same package/version, direct declared range and compatible selected group, with candidate-limit uncertainty.
package-adoption-2.friction: Local keys/inventory and complete binding before selecting three relevant facets. HAL views total 9,762 B. No resource refetch.
package-adoption-2.stopping: Stops after ordinary query evidence; retrospective identifies manifest repetition as unnecessary.

package-adoption-3.domain: Satisfied for the reported package's direct Polly declaration; search predicate is broader than exact Polly identity.
package-adoption-3.mechanism: Help, command HAL, rejected -Q depends, -Q Packages, one starts-with query.
package-adoption-3.evidence: Returned package independently contains an exact Polly declaration and Polly.Extensions.Http. Selected .NETStandard2.0 applies to net10.0; forty-candidate prefix search is not exhaustive.
package-adoption-3.friction: Reads nearly the entire embedded dataset (18,045 B across HAL views), then seeks --where syntax. -Q expects a section rather than a facet. One recorded jq syntax error occurs while reading the ordinary result.
package-adoption-3.stopping: No package-detail verification. Retrospective says -Q recovery was for precise syntax; the registered binding lacks the explicit starts-with lowering while -Q provides it. Follow-up #9962 records this scoped gap.

package-adoption-4.domain: Satisfied for a bounded direct declaration answer after one rejected query.
package-adoption-4.mechanism: Help, brief -Q, -Q Packages, invalid depth-four/forty-candidate request, corrected exact direct query.
package-adoption-4.evidence: Same inspected package/version and direct declaration; selected group, candidate limit and indirect uncertainty are qualified.
package-adoption-4.friction: Already viewed -Q Packages states the five-candidate nuspec-expensive cap before the depth-four request. This is failure to apply present guidance, not missing registration. Seed Microsoft.Extensions* differs from the other participants' Microsoft.Extensions.*; candidate populations are not asserted equal.
package-adoption-4.stopping: Uses returned manifest evidence, no resource navigation or package-detail verification.

limits: Four fresh, nonrandomized participants with one accurate guide; adoption and cost are observations, not causal/population conclusions.
Previous study used an 1845 B Member-only guide and different source; this guide is 2153 B and teaches landed Package Query admission. Historical costs are descriptive.
Three HAL readers retrieve 21,913 to 24,922 guidance bytes versus 6,272 B for the -Q reader; local HAL reading remains broad. Neither establishes format superiority or measured latency.
All participants answer one bounded direct match. No actual indirect traversal, restore graph, exhaustive survey or at-most-three completeness claim is established.
Live NuGet search is not snapshotted; identical observed result/version does not establish identical candidate sets or cache fairness.
No schema/link reads occurred; this sample does not exercise a necessary-navigation boundary or prove future agents will always stop.
Retrospectives are collected only after all original outputs are frozen. Self-reports explain stated intent but do not prove necessity or causality.
Raw CLI retrieval, local rendering and guide bytes are distinct; none is a token/context, NuGet download, latency or production transfer measurement.
Author worked jq selection is produced after trials from a retained response. It is an optimization illustration, not participant evidence or a measured guide intervention.
